name: cekas-app
description: CEKAS (Catatan Keuangan Kelas) - MVP Telegram Bot with Google Cloud Firestore
author: Kelompok 5 (XI-F2 SMA Kartika XIX-1 Bandung)

scripts.web: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{const p=path.join(__dirname,'web',req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url);fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}else{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':p.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':'text/javascript'});res.end(d);}})}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('🚀 CEKAS Web running at http://localhost:3000'))"
